notablePrerequisites:
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least six other Shrines.
description:
At the beginning of your end step, Go-Shintai triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Go-Shintai's ability.
Resolve the copy of Go-Shintai's ability, paying {1} to create at least seven 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six Spirit tokens, adding {5}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
